blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Wednesday ordered the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to address funding and implementation concerns surrounding the Samal Island-Davao City Connector (SIDC) project, according to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO). During the 12th Economy and Development Council Meeting in Malacañang, Marcos spearheaded the review of projects aimed at ensuring more reliable power, improving flood protection, reducing travel time, expanding access to education, and strengthening social protection. “Residents and businesses in Davao City and the Island Garden City of Samal are expected to benefit from faster, more convenient travel with the completion of […]...
